art_style: Flat geometric linework with squared terminals and enough negative space to hold up at avatar size.

abstract mark.reason: A compact relationship can suggest a graph and remain legible in a square avatar.

pictorial mark.reason: A repository artifact makes the evidence purpose recognizable in a small silhouette.

lettermark.reason: The name is locked. Its initials give first-time readers little context at avatar size.

concepts.art_style: A compact geometric silhouette with a strong diagonal and squared terminals.
concepts.example: Join a short horizontal source bar to a tall index tab with a single upward diagonal. Cut a shallow rectangular notch into the tab.
concepts.rationale: The diagonal is a graph relationship, the source bar is a specific line and the index tab is its filed evidence. The tab notch may need to widen at avatar size.

concepts.art_style: Two squared brackets and a continuous stepped line.
concepts.example: Place offset brackets on the left and right with a stepped line that starts inside one bracket and terminates inside the other.
concepts.rationale: The brackets quote two exact locations, the path traces their relationship and the offsets show a change in context. Standalone brackets can read as a generic developer mark.

concepts.art_style: Two offset document silhouettes with a shared diagonal cut.
concepts.example: Pair a solid graph sheet with an outlined receipt behind it. Align their top corners along one diagonal.
concepts.rationale: The front sheet is the graph export, the rear sheet is its companion receipt and the common corner signals the shared source. The overlap needs room to read.

selection_reason: Filed Edge leads at 95 / 100. Its single path and index tab combine navigation and verification in the smallest proposed silhouette.
